modules.purpose: `cloudevents` is Golib's transport-independent CloudEvents interoperability envelope. It implements the stable 1.0 information model, deterministic JSON event and batch serialization, and selected HTTP and Kafka mappings. It does not replace richer domain, event-sourcing, outbox, queue, workflow, audit, or application envelopes.
modules.family_description: Standards, envelopes, schemas, descriptions, signatures, and wire interoperability.

cohesion.responsibility: Provide a transport-independent CloudEvents 1.0 envelope with bounded JSON, HTTP, and Kafka mappings.
non_goals: Own application event taxonomies, brokers, dispatch, persistence, workflow, audit, or schema registries.
Perform hidden transport I/O, schema lookup, registration, telemetry initialization, or background work.

package_selection.github.com/faustbrian/go-cloudevents: Use for CloudEvents information-model and wire interoperability; retain a richer domain envelope when it owns application, persistence, workflow, or settlement state.

conformance_corpora: cloudevents/conformance v0.4.1 HTTP and Kafka features

modules.purpose: `golib` is the deprecated compatibility facade between the transport-independent CloudEvents package and Golib's canonical event, transport, workflow, metadata, audit, and schema contracts. It remains available for v1 compatibility but is excluded from the recommended set because it brings the complete 26-dependency bridge into one module. Importing it performs no registration, network access, schema lookup, telemetry emission, or background work.
modules.family_description: Standards, envelopes, schemas, descriptions, signatures, and wire interoperability.

cohesion.responsibility: Preserve v1 compatibility for the former broad CloudEvents bridge while callers migrate to independently versioned target adapters.
non_goals: Replace the canonical domain, store, queue, workflow, audit, telemetry, or transport state owned by another package.
Perform import-time registration, network access, schema lookup, telemetry emission, or background work.
Provide a new umbrella runtime or require the adapter for core CloudEvents use.

package_selection.github.com/faustbrian/go-cloudevents/ada: Deprecated compatibility facade; retain for existing v1 consumers only. New code and migrations use the relevant target-oriented adapter from the parent adoption guide.
